relationships.subject: HDAC2
relationships.evidence_quote: Elevated HDAC2 expression has been linked to changes in spine density, synaptic connectivity, and memory processes, suggesting that it plays a significant role in neuroplasticity

relationships.subject: 11β-HSD2
relationships.evidence_quote: The enzyme 11β-HSD2 (11β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2) oxidizes cortisol to its biologically inactive form cortisone to prevent it from negatively interacting with the developing fetus

relationships.subject: maternal immune activation
relationships.evidence_quote: maternal immune activity has been linked to reduced expression of GAD1 and GAD2 in the prefrontal cortex (PFC) of offspring in a murine model

key_findings: Review linking perinatal trauma (e.g. in utero IPV) to epigenetic programming and adolescent chronic pain risk.
Maternal cortisol and immune activation alter fetal epigenome and GABAergic development.
